en.headline: Fire breaks out in Sham Shui Po tenement staircase, no injuries
en.dek: Clutter caught alight in the back staircase of a building on Un Chau Street early Friday; firefighters extinguished the blaze within minutes and no one was evacuated.
body: Police received a report at 2.57am of smoke and fire in the back staircase of a tenement building at 68-70 Un Chau Street in Sham Shui Po.
Firefighters arrived, deployed one jet and a breathing apparatus team, and brought the fire under control by 3.12am. No one was injured and residents did not need to be evacuated.

Initial investigations suggest the fire was caused by burning clutter in the staircase and was not suspicious. A section of Un Chau Street between Pei Ho Street and Yen Chow Street was temporarily closed for the operation.

zh.headline: 深水埗唐樓後樓梯雜物起火 無人受傷毋須疏散
zh.dek: 周五凌晨元州街一幢唐樓後樓梯雜物起火，消防在數分鐘內撲滅，沒有人受傷或需要疏散。
body: 警方凌晨2時57分接報，指深水埗元州街68至70號一幢唐樓後樓梯冒煙起火。
消防到場後開喉及派出呼吸器隊伍，於3時12分將火勢撲滅。沒有人受傷，住客亦毋須疏散。
初步調查顯示，起火原因是後樓梯雜物焚燒，事件不涉及可疑。行動期間，元州街介乎卑路乍街至欽州街一段一度封閉。
